# proficiency level

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:proficiencyLevel`](gmeow-proficiencyLevel.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/proficiencyLevel>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/languages`](../../slices/languages.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The attained level of a language-proficiency (a [`gmeow:ProficiencyLevel`](../classes/gmeow-ProficiencyLevel.md) value, e.g. [`cefrB2`](../individuals/gmeow-cefrB2.md), [`levelNative`](../individuals/gmeow-levelNative.md)). Functional.

- **Source:** [`slices/extensions/languages/examples/proficiency.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/extensions/languages/examples/proficiency.ttl)

```turtle
# --- Strong at READING French (B2) ...
ex:frenchReading a gmeow:LanguageProficiency ;
    gmeow:proficiencyAgent    ex:dana ;
    gmeow:proficiencyLanguage gmeow:langFrench ;
    gmeow:proficiencyModality gmeow:profModalityReading ;
    gmeow:proficiencyLevel    ex:b2 ;
    gmeow:proficiencyScale    ex:cefr .

# --- ... but only A2 SPEAKING it — same language, different modality.
ex:frenchSpeaking a gmeow:LanguageProficiency ;
    gmeow:proficiencyAgent    ex:dana ;
    gmeow:proficiencyLanguage gmeow:langFrench ;
    gmeow:proficiencyModality gmeow:profModalitySpeaking ;
    gmeow:proficiencyLevel    ex:a2 ;
    gmeow:proficiencyScale    ex:cefr .
```
